ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The contour lines in the figure as a whole extend in a southwest—northeast direction; in the lower left there is a closed contour circle marked as a, and toward the right side and northeast direction contour lines marked as b and c can be seen in sequence; the question stem gives the value relationship as a>b>c, indicating that the area near a in the lower left is a relatively high-value area, and the values gradually decrease toward the upper right or northeast direction. Then reason: If these contour lines represent the atmospheric pollution index during a certain period, pollutants usually diffuse and are transported from the high-pollution area toward the downwind direction under the action of the prevailing wind. Wind directions are named according to the direction from which the wind comes, so the prevailing wind direction should be southwest wind.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中等值线呈西南—东北向拉长，a 等值线在左下方且为高值核心，b、c 依次向右上/东北方向展开，且文字给出 a>b>c。再推理：污染物从高值区向低值区扩散并沿主导风向被输送，因此输送方向约为由西南指向东北。风向按来向命名，所以该时段主导风向可能为西南风。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the isoline pattern: the closed high-value contour labeled a lies in the lower-left/southwest part; lower-value contours b and c extend successively toward the upper-right/northeast, and the dashed line marks an elongated southwest–northeast axis.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：a 为最高值闭合圈，位于图的左下偏西南；b、c 为较低值线，整体向右上偏东北一侧偏移拉长，说明污染范围在东北侧拖出“尾迹”。再推理：污染尾迹所在方向是下风向，即风把污染物吹向东北；主导风的来向与下风向相反，为西南方。因此答案为西南风。

It is weakly distinct because it still relies on the same pollution-plume principle.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read that the highest contour a is a small closed loop in the southwest/lower-left, while the larger lower-value isolines b and c are not concentric around it but are displaced and opened toward the northeast/upper-right side.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text condition a>b>c to identify a as the high-value污染中心 and b、c as progressively lower-value contours; use the question’s specification that these are atmospheric pollution index isolines.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A point/area pollution source under persistent wind produces asymmetric isolines: the low-concentration plume tail is stretched to the leeward side. The leeward side indicates where the wind blows toward; the named wind direction is the opposite, the wind’s source direction.
